      "observations": [
        "Read all 14 changed paths and the full 908-line owned diff. Six production UI paths record certificateExceptionAdded: calendar provider, get-messages notification, configuration verifier, compose send listener, CardDAV utilities and the account-settings widget. Seven test files add event checks. The commit explicitly omits IM, Feeds, address-book search and the toolkit Certificate Manager. Low expected usage is a hypothesis, not observed telemetry.",
        "The event has error_category, protocol, port and ui extras. The schema declares all four as strings, but written call sites and expected fixtures pass numeric ports or the widget string port. No generated binding or conversion behavior was inferred. Calendar and URI-based paths replace port -1 with the scheme default. The calendar protocol uses calendar type when present, otherwise URI scheme; CardDAV uses a fixed carddav value. No hostname or account identifier is added in this schema.",
        "Dialog paths wait for the matching domwindowclosed and check exceptionAdded. Alert and compose observers remove themselves before returning on cancellation. Configuration verification records before retrying login; CardDAV records before retrying the final channel URI, while non-certificate failures or missing security information reject early. Calendar records independently of whether a calendar can refresh. The initial widget records after directly remembering the override; accepted current code instead records after dialog confirmation. These are action events, not successful authentication or retry-completion events.",
        "Current calendar, configuration and CardDAV recording boundaries remain. The current alert takes a server key and returns on lookup failure, unlike the initial URI lookup with URI-scheme fallback. Current compose additionally guards an absent gCurrentIdentity after the dialog closes. The initial callback reads the current identity at closure; this inspection does not prove all identity changes or opener-close paths. ConfigVerifier retains a nearby legacy nullable-security-info comment, so this packet does not claim all protocol error inputs are nonnull.",
        "Tests reset FOG in the relevant fixture setup or scenario, accept fake certificate errors, and assert one event and all four extras. New CardDAV acceptance cases preserve the old cancellation case and use a real CardDAV fixture behind a wrong-host HTTPS proxy. The test directly checks discovery results and an override; the earlier unrelated HTTPS fixture could not establish a successful CardDAV retry. The account-hub test now has one final login and handler cleanup, not a duplicated cleanup before event checks. No xpcshell replacement was implemented.",
        "Manual style checks include the clearer uri parameter, updated nsIURI JSDoc, early rejection guard, matching-dialog observer removal, separate recording and retry steps, and reason comments for the alert server-versus-URI fallback. Existing compose focus-delay suppression moved earlier; it is not a recommended wait pattern. Sixteen changed Assert calls were checked: fourteen telemetry assertions lack messages, and two override checks have expected-behavior messages. No test, telemetry collection, preference change, exception creation, build, lint or UI check ran.",
        "Read complete retained Bug 1983982 description, comments 0–5, updates and end controls. The purpose is to measure unknown exception usage; the low-usage comments are assumptions, not results. Comment 4 contains the scoped data-review approval: interaction data, standard telemetry controls, a named monitor, default-on, no new identifiers, existing notice coverage and no third-party tool. The attachment body and external dictionary links were not opened. This approval applies to this requested collection, not to arbitrary future metrics.",
        "Read complete D261684 timeline, six actual submitted inline bodies 1434320, 1434371, 1434530, 1435043, 1437064 and 1437403, and the actual Old/New summary pair. The summary adds the explicit omitted IM, Feeds, address-book-search and toolkit Certificate Manager scope. No actual usage count is reported.",
        "Adoption was checked against exact landed source. ConfigVerifier now receives an nsIURI and uses asciiHostPort in the dialog and log strings. This does not establish a global URI-display rule: CardDAV intentionally retains originalURI.displayHostPort for its dialog. The initial calendar no-test note is superseded by the added discovery event assertions. A suggested UI-independent xpcshell test remains unimplemented.",
        "The CardDAV review first interprets a failed retry as a possible product bug. The author later identifies the old test fixture as an ordinary mochitest HTTPS server that cannot speak CardDAV. The final source retains cancellation and adds separate acceptance tests using a CardDAV server with a wrong-host HTTPS proxy. The account-hub duplicate-cleanup concern is resolved in exact source by one cleanup after event checks. These written test expectations are not fresh test results.",
        "Historical failed, completed and ongoing build reports, later stack rearrangement and final approvals are retained as distinct timeline events. Landing with ongoing or failed builds does not establish a new execution result here. The parent commit is 3441 in this fixed Git history; later review dependency changes do not change that exact source ordering."
